_comment: Anti-regrowth ratchet baseline for tool/metrics_ratchet_check.dart. Counts = number of functions whose dart_code_linter metric level is 'warning' or 'alarm', per metric, over lib/ after the analysis_options.yaml metrics-exclude. Captured 2026-05-22 against origin/master by running `dart run dart_code_linter:metrics analyze lib/ --reporter=json`. The ratchet only tightens: LOWER these as the refactor phase reduces violations; raising any value needs explicit operator approval (CLAUDE.md 'Ceiling-raise rule R-2'). 2026-05-22 reconciliation: cyclomatic-complexity 261->262 with explicit operator approval. The +1 was pre-existing drift from operator-web PRs #1185-#1198 (merged after the 261 capture at #1183) that did not refresh this file; verified against clean origin/master (262 with and without UX-parity PR #1201), so NOT introduced by the alignment work. To be ratcheted back DOWN as the admin<->operator alignment slices adopt shared widgets and reduce per-function complexity. 2026-05-25 reconciliation: source-lines-of-code 338->330 (locking a real reduction), cyclomatic-complexity 262->265, and number-of-parameters 122->123, with explicit operator approval. Verified that PR #1309 (friendly Vendor Applicability redesign + per-location write path) added ZERO dart_code_linter violations to its own changed lib/ files ('no issues found' on the screen, catalog, and gateway), so the +3 cyclomatic / +1 parameter is pre-existing drift from other admin/operator-web PRs merged since the 262 capture, NOT introduced by #1309. Captured against origin/master at the #1309 merge commit 8f239498. 2026-05-25 tightening (operator-directed): source-lines-of-code 330->324 and cyclomatic-complexity 265->261, locking in PR #1314's behavior-preserving decompose (which reversed the +3 cyclomatic drift) plus a net source-lines reduction. number-of-parameters held at 123 (the two 9-parameter Postgres repository methods deleteCap / updatePlanPricing are proxy-called RLS/catalog writes, not safely param-grouped). Verified `dart run tool/metrics_ratchet_check.dart` GO against origin/master a7644585. See runbooks/dart_code_metrics_runbook.md.
